evaluationStatus: retrospective short-record sensitivity; no fresh holdout or measured production

choice.interpretation: Descriptive minimax regret over tested scenarios, not out-of-sample evidence or future probabilities. Ties are retained.

limitations: Four years only. Omitted-year cases are retrospective diagnostics, not forecasting tests.
Regret improvement is descriptive over the same finite scenarios used to choose the robust option.
Method scores and seam jumps are diagnostics, not proof of measured accuracy.
Options are a bounded hypothetical grid, not surveyed feasibility or a global optimum.
The energy objective does not establish financial value.
